Easily connected with the included adapter and stays connected with no issues. Two options for your preferred system ear muffs, synthetic leather and clotth.

reviews.title: Works great, good quality, only about 20ft working distance
reviews.comment: Been using for a little over a year now. They have good sound, the mic works great, and they connect instantly everytime. Only con is they only have about a 20ft working distance from my computer which is kind of annoying if I'm on discord chatting with friends while doing something in the room immediately next to mine. My brothers steel brand seem to work no matter where he is in the house
reviews.author: Ryan

reviews.title: Do not buy this and save your money.
reviews.comment: The headset randomly shut off and and restarts cutting out randomly and crackling for 3-10 seconds.  I have had this issue before but then it went away a few months ago but it is back and worse than before.  The battery level doesn't matter and can happen plugged in or not.  So I have been trying to fix this myself for the last week or so with what I can find online.  I have made sure all my drivers are up to date.  I have confirmed the firmware is up to date.  I uninstalled G-hub, the headset from device manager, restarted, reinstalled both.  I have made sure the dongle is fine.  I tried various USB ports of direct to MB and PC case ports.  I have reset the dongle and headset with the little pin reset buttons.  I have tried having the surround sound off in G hub.  I have shut off any windows settings changing anything in sounds settings.  I have tried each of the different audio qualities in the sounds settings.  And various combinations of the above.  It's driving me insane.  I reached out for support finally after trying to fix it myself for hours and no response.  Nothing from Logitech.  the 1o minute wait for a rep was over an hour before I gave up.  No phone reps only online chat and no response.  Seriously buy any other product Logitech is not the same company from 6 years ago that made great products.  Now its basically intel, apple, and blackberry.  Just waaayyyyyyy too high a price for low or mid level quality of as product with 0 support.

reviews.title: Great gaming headphones
reviews.comment: I did have some problems with Logitech GHub app on windows 11 . I wish Logitech would just have drivers available without having to install additional software . Install ghub extract driver and uninstall Ghub worked for me . I dint find much difference with GHub software configurations, but that just me . If anyone else has problems with the GH software, what work for me was launching app, and ghub processes As administrator .
